paragraphs.text: Isu is a legendary yeti from an unknown plane.

Isu the Abominable is a legendary Yeti hailing from the icy, uncharted realms of an unknown plane. Its gray hide is thick and cold-resistant, with a whorl pattern. The undersides of Isu's arms are covered in a thick coat of snow-white fur, and two great tusks protrude from its chin. Isu strides through the snow-laden peaks as an embodiment of the primal forces of winter.
